name: mr-guided-review
description: Use when you want to understand and review a GitLab MR as a reasoning companion rather than an automated reviewer. Phase 1 explains the MR's goal and purpose concisely with a concrete example, then gates on your confirmation before Phase 2 does a thorough code review that reports genuine issues, not nitpicks, as a one-line-per-finding index you can expand. Phase 3, only on your explicit go-ahead, drafts review comments in your voice and stages them as unpublished draft notes. Never publishes a review, never posts a plain comment, never approves. Triggers when you want to review, understand, walk through, or draft review comments on an MR.
